title: Guidence regarding multiple compliances on same site

posts.cooked:
Hello everyone,

I have customized and rebranded my Frappe/ERPNext site which is being used by customers from different countries. For their requirements, I installed multiple tax compliance applications (e.g., Uganda Compliance, Burundi Compliance) on the same site.

The problem is that these compliance apps are conflicting with each other. For example, a customer from Uganda is seeing errors related to Burundi compliance settings, and vice versa. This clearly should not happen.

I tried to work around this by monkey patching some whitelisted methods and customizing them, but I don’t think this is a good long-term solution since it’s not practical (or safe) to override code for every compliance app from different countries.

One idea I have is to create a separate site per country, and install only the relevant compliance app on that site.

Can anyone please guide me if this is the right approach, or suggest best practices for handling multi-country compliance apps?

Thanks in advance!
